notes.title: L.S.D. PROLOGUE OUT NOW!
notes.content:
"L.S.D. Prologue to Lasting Spiritual Derangement" out now!
Hi all! 
The demo has been out for a couple of days already and it's going great!
Receiving all this positive feedback and interest about my game really motivates me to work on the game as hard as I can!
Please contact me anywhere and anytime if you have anything to say about the game! 
Starting from this post!
Take care!
And play the demo!!!
-S.F.

notes.title: Wishlist L.S.D. + Demo coming soon (update on the development) - by S.F.
notes.content:
Hi user!
I hope you're as glas as I am to know that L.S.D. is gathering a lot of wishlists!
As a solo developer this really excites me and encourages me to work as hard as I can on the creation of my game.
The development of the game is keeping me really busy but I'm happy to finally announce that "L.S.D.: Prologue", the playable demo of the game, is coming soon on Steam!
I hope the prologue will keep up with the expectations and that it will build even more hype for the release of the complete official game.
Also, here's the link to our Discord server in case you want to join: https://discord.gg/WBpSjv3qpd
See ya

-S.F.

notes.title: Welcome to the community hub!
notes.content:
The Steam page for L.S.D. is finally online!
ːsteamhappyː

You can also join the Fabiulous Games' newborn community on Discord, through this link: https://discord.gg/WBpSjv3qpd
